items.title: Journalist to be crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute
items.dek: Kijanangoma is being crowned amid a dispute over a young heir whom the royal clan does not recognise.

items.title: Tennessee governor rejects clemency bid for Christa Pike as execution looms
items.dek: If the execution proceeds, Pike would be the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than 200 years.
